title: What to Practice Next? Latent Profile-Guided Task Selection for Skill-Evolving LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.18818v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Task selection shapes the experiences available for skill evolution in LLM agents, yet fixed practice schedules overlook differences in skill requirements and evolving task value. Most existing methods, however, rely on fixed schedules or scalar measures of progress, leaving nonstationary skill demands unaddressed. We propose SPG-Select, a framework for allocating limited practice budget using a multidimensional profile inferred from binary outcomes via MIRT. The framework predicts surrogate progress, defined as the difference between consecutive profile estimates, and prioritizes progress in dimensions with larger estimated proficiency gaps. Our SPG-Select-R policy combines these predictions with uncertainty-based exploration and periodic restarting to accommodate nonstationarity. translated_title: 下一步练习什么？面向技能演化LLM智能体的潜在画像引导任务选择
translated_abstract: 任务选择决定了LLM智能体技能演化过程中可获得的经验，然而固定的练习计划忽视了技能需求的差异以及任务价值的动态变化。现有大多数方法依赖于固定的计划或标量式的进度衡量，未能应对非平稳的技能需求。我们提出SPG-Select，一个基于多维画像来分配有限练习预算的框架，该画像通过MIRT（多维项目反应理论）从二元结果中推断得出。该框架预测替代进度（定义为相邻两次画像估计之间的差异），并优先在估计熟练度差距较大的维度上推进练习。我们的SPG-Select-R策略将这些预测与基于不确定性的探索以及周期性重启相结合，以适应非平稳性。我们在ALFWorld和WebShop上使用三种技能演化后端对SPG-Select进行了评估。在报告的实验中，SPG-Select-R取得了更高的平均保留测试终止成功率。
tldr: 提出SPG-Select框架，利用MIRT从二元结果推断多维技能画像、预测各维度替代进度并优先练习熟练度差距大的任务，结合不确定性探索与周期性重启，从而在非平稳技能需求下更高效地分配LLM智能体的有限练习预算。
